rationale: The Latin anchors *unguis* and *ungula* specifically denote the nail/claw/hoof as a horny covering (not the whole foot), and the phrase *qui ungulam non dividunt* ("those who do not divide the hoof") likewise refers to the keratinous structure itself. This aligns with hoof.n.02 ("the horny covering of the end of the foot in ungulate mammals") rather than hoof.n.01, which denotes the entire foot.
